name: Carbon Credit
description: A tradable carbon credit (ERC-20) where 1 token = 1 tonne of CO2e (a Verified Carbon Unit). Minting issues credits from a verified project, transfers trade them between KYC-verified registry participants, and burning permanently retires a credit so it can never be double-counted. Freeze places a compliance hold on an account.

registry.description: Issuing registry, e.g. Verra / Gold Standard

vintage.description: Vintage year the credits were generated

sourcePlotAssetId.description: Asset id of the RWA plot (e.g. a bamboo-plot asset) this credit batch's sequestration was verified against, if the project also tokenizes the underlying land — optional; most carbon-credit projects have no linked RWA plot

endUseDurability.description: Whether the biomass this credit is claimed against ends up in a durable carbon pool. DURABLE: panel, construction, or biochar pathways. NON_DURABLE: combustion end-uses (e.g. agarbatti round-stick, biomass fuel) — the carbon is released on a short horizon and such volumes should be excluded from removal claims. Optional; most non-biomass carbon projects (e.g. avoidance methodologies) leave this unset.

methodologyTrack.description: For a biomass-sourced credit: A_ARR (standing-biomass afforestation/reforestation removals, e.g. Verra VM0047) or B_BIOCHAR (durable biochar from processing residue, e.g. Verra VM0044 / Puro.earth). The two tracks have different permanence profiles, pricing and MRV — optional, most non-biomass credits leave this unset.

quantificationApproach.description: For Track A_ARR credits: CENSUS_BASED (dispersed plantings — bund, boundary, intercrop — enumerated one by one, no control plots needed) or AREA_BASED (block plantings on land-use-changed land, requires matched control plots and a dynamic performance benchmark). Locked for the credit's whole crediting period once chosen — this field records that choice, it does not enforce immutability. Optional; only meaningful for A_ARR.

netTco2ePerHaLifetime.description: Net tCO2e per hectare over the full crediting period, AFTER buffer, leakage and uncertainty deductions, computed from a declining sequestration curve (fast early growth to an equilibrium plateau, not a flat annual rate). A flat-rate projection typically overstates lifetime volume by roughly 3.5x and is the first thing a validation body flags — always populate this from the curve model, never from (assumed annual rate × years). Optional; only meaningful for biomass-sourced credits.

bufferPct.description: Non-permanence buffer-pool contribution, as a percentage of gross credits withheld against reversal risk (e.g. fire, disease, land-use reversal). Typically 15-20% for smallholder Indian agroforestry under ARR methodologies. Optional.

uncertaintyDeductionPct.description: Conservative deduction applied for measurement/model uncertainty in the underlying growth attestation, before net issuance. Optional.

carbonRegistryBinding.description: Which registry this specific credit batch is issued under, in the same controlled vocabulary as sourcePlotAssetId's plot-level carbonRegistryBinding field (NONE, VERRA_VM0047, BEE_CCTS, GOLD_STANDARD) — 'registry' above is free text for display, this is the machine-comparable cross-check value. When sourcePlotAssetId is set, this SHOULD match that plot's own carbonRegistryBinding; a mismatch means the same land is being claimed under two different registries, which is double-counting. The platform does not check this automatically — it must be compared manually. Optional.
